name: AgentRail
label: Agent rail
description: The companion rail of an agent product: the agent's portrait over tabbed panes for activity, approvals, automations, and personalization.

props.name: profile
props.description: The agent this rail belongs to, rendered as the header's portrait block.

props.name: tabs
props.description: The rail's tabs, in display order. Each carries its own pane.

props.name: value
props.description:
Id of the tab on stage. The rail is fully controlled by design, so the
host owns the state: it holds no hooks and renders from a Server Component.
Falls back to the first tab.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the chosen tab's id.

props.name: tabsLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the tab strip.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Legacy accessible-name prop for the rail.

props.name: onCollapse
props.description:
Fires when the rail's collapse affordance is pressed. The button renders
only when this is given, pinned to the rail's top trailing corner. It is
a chevron rather than a cross on purpose: the host's own close control
is usually a cross a few pixels away, and two of them side by side read
as two ways to dismiss the same thing.

props.name: collapseLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the collapse affordance.

props.name: collapseVariant
props.description: How the collapse affordance is drawn. `chevron` (the default) pins a chevron to the leading corner, clear of a host's own controls. `close` pins a cross to the trailing corner, for a rail that is its card's only way out or whose host wants the way out where a panel's close usually is.

props.name: footer
props.description: Rendered under the pane, outside its scroll — a sign-out row, a quiet hint.
